documentTitle: ドキュメントタイトル
detailed_description: Markdown to PDF converter transforms your Markdown documents into professionally formatted PDF files. Supports headings, lists, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, and more. Customize font size and page size before generating.
usage_steps: Enter or paste your Markdown content
Set the document title for the PDF
Choose font size and page size
Click Generate PDF to create and download
usage_examples: Convert documentation to PDF for sharing
Create printable reports from Markdown notes
Generate PDF versions of README files
